changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Guided tour of the tenant: the personal auto-start switch and the progress of each role of a person.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE guided_tour_profile ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_keycloak_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT REFERENCES app_user (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, auto_start_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, legacy_invitation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, insert_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, insert_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, edit_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, entity_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_guided_tour_profile_active_subject ON guided_tour_profile (user_keycloak_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE;
CREATE TABLE guided_tour_progress ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, profile_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES guided_tour_profile (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, seen_steps JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, last_step_id VARCHAR(64), auto_proposals SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, catalog_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, started_at TIMESTAMPTZ, completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, insert_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, insert_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, edit_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, entity_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_role CHECK (role IN ('ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN', 'ROLE_ADMIN', 'ROLE_BOARD', 'ROLE_TREASURER', 'ROLE_ARCHIVIST', 'ROLE_USER', 'ROLE_USER_EXTERNAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_status CHECK (status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED')), CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_steps CHECK ( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(seen_steps) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(seen_steps) <= 100 ELSE FALSE END ), CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_proposals CHECK (auto_proposals BETWEEN 0 AND 3), CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_revision CHECK (catalog_revision >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_guided_tour_progress_completed CHECK ((status = 'COMPLETED') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_guided_tour_progress_active_role ON guided_tour_progress (profile_id, role) WHERE deleted = FALSE;

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE guided_tour_progress; DROP TABLE guided_tour_profile;

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: The members already in the tenant at the release receive the invitation instead of the automatic start.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO guided_tour_profile(user_keycloak_id, user_id, auto_start_enabled, legacy_invitation, deleted, insert_date, insert_by, edit_date, edit_by, entity_version) SELECT u.keycloak_id, u.id, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', 0 FROM app_user u WHERE u.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guided_tour_profile profile WHERE profile.user_keycloak_id = u.keycloak_id AND profile.deleted = FALSE);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM guided_tour_profile WHERE legacy_invitation = TRUE;
